nodes.label: .`starting opens a new attempt at the phone step with a Telegram session`()
.`starting again from another device resumes the same attempt and ignores the body`()
.`cancel discards the attempt and its Telegram session, then start begins at the phone step`()
.`fifteen minutes without a step discards the attempt in the sweep`()
.`a Sign-in Session that ends mid-wizard discards the attempt on the next read and in the sweep`()
.`an ended session also discards the attempt on start, which then begins fresh`()
.`an Owner below the limit can add another account`()
.`an Owner at the limit is refused with the limit and nothing opens`()
.`sign in again targets only the Owner's Session lost account and skips the limit check`()
.`starting without Telegram credentials is refused as not set up and opens nothing`()
.`starting without a master key is refused as not set up`()
